caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular pattern composed of small, uniformly-shaped, brick-like units arranged in a diagonal grid, creating a woven plaid appearance. The design is divided into a 3x3 grid structure, with each section displaying different color combinations that blend into one another at the intersections. The colors featured are yellow, green, light blue, dark blue, brown, beige, and shades of tan, which transition diagonally across the grid, forming areas of overlapping hues where rows and columns meet. The background is a plain, uncolored surface, and the pattern occupies a central rectangular space, leaving a border of blank area around the design.
title: Jerga (Carpet)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
